commands.name: grant

args.name: grant-id
args.description: The grant identifier returned by `kye grant issue`.

flags.description: KYE ID of the principal authorising the grant.
KYE ID of the grantee receiving authority.

commands.help_text:
kye grant <subcommand>

Subcommands:
  issue --principal <kyeid> --grantee <kyeid> --purpose <kyeid> --scope <json>
  list  [--tenant <id>] [--actor <kyeid>] [--principal <kyeid>] [--limit <n>]
  revoke <grant-id> --reason <code> [--cascade]
  get   <grant-id>
commands.example: kye grant issue --principal kye:user:acme:alice --grantee kye:agent:acme:bot --purpose kye:purpose:read_payments
